title: Union Church, Hong Kong
axis: X follows the lower Kennedy Road frontage toward east; Z points uphill into the old church site.
source: OpenStreetMap archived 2017 place of worship site

features.role: Original pre-demolition place of worship site, archived in the 2017 feature history.

identityStatus: Combines the archived 2017 place of worship polygon, the published address and the original 2007 site photographs. The distinct named present facility verifies the persistent site identity.

terrainContact.basis: Lands Department original 5 m datum on Kennedy Road immediately along the old granite retaining terrace.

notes: The original Hong Kong 5 m elevation grid determines the Kennedy Road retaining grade. The old sanctuary and freestanding tower are proportioned from the 2007 reference and the official architectural description.
